did: Pinned home's moment log as a contract, which closed the Bites page story, and moved the live game's fixture to engine version 8. Built the Game Week essay's template with section 0's rules held in its data, so the essay can never recreate a game play by play. Then, with the server worker, agreed home's weekly file for the essay and the claims' list, and built the phone side of each: the mailbox's place for the week file and for the essay's script, the essay filed where home says each bite belongs, its scenes, cut list and chapters, its stage on the web, its recorder and a thumbnail look of its own. All of it waits on branches for the coordinator's bucket.

calls.title: The claims' list is part of the one scenario catalog
options: Catalog version 3, home's and the phone's from one dump
A list kept on the phone alone
A list home sends with each verdict
calls.why: Home computes the measures and keeps the ledger, so one catalog both read, held together by the fixture check, is the family that already exists.
calls.undo: Drop the claims part from the catalog and set its version back to 2, before any phone records version 3.

calls.title: A Game Week essay covers Tuesday to Monday
options: Tuesday to Monday, named by its Sunday's week
Monday to Sunday, as the other essays
calls.why: One NFL week is one essay, so a Monday night game stays with its Sunday.
calls.undo: Move the week check in the mailbox and in the essay's template to Monday to Sunday, and tell home's week file.

calls.title: Home says where each bite goes in its game
options: Home's week file names each bite's place
The template guesses from the scenario and kickoff
calls.why: Only home can tell a bite said before the first play from one said after the final; a review found the template's guess put an after-the-final remark in the first half.
calls.undo: Have home send halves again and give the template a rule of its own.

calls.title: The Game Week essay's thumbnail is a deep crimson gridiron
options: A deep crimson field beside a voice's waveform
Teal, between the status dots' sky and leaf
calls.why: A red no other genre has, dark enough to stay apart from the report's coral for colour-blind eyes, showing the one image the essay draws.
calls.undo: Change its colour or shape in the genres file.
